case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 1401 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 4530 OF 2019

parties.respondent: Dr. (Mrs.) Manjeet Kaur Monga (D) through her LR & Anr.

summary: Home buyer's allotment cancelled after partial payment; refund delayed despite Pay Order; MRTP unfair trade practice finding upheld; COMPAT awarded compound interest @15% till cancellation date; matter remanded to consider post-cancellation interest and bank's role; NCLAT awarded further interest from 1st May 2005 to 7th May 2016; dispute over interest calculation period and Citibank's liability; final compliance with refund only in 2016.
legal_provisions_cited: Ghaziabad Development Authority vs. Ved Prakash Agarwal
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of; matter remanded to COMPAT with directions to implead Citibank; developer directed to pay compensation with 15% compound interest up to 30th April 2005; NCLAT's order affirmed with direction for further interest from 1st May 2005 till realization.
